'''Taisa''' is a ''[[sul'dam]]'' under [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]]. 

== Appearance ==
She has dark eyes and wears the dark blue dress of the ''sul'dam'', with red panels embroidered with forked silver lightning on the breast and on the sides of her skirt.

== Activities ==
She holds the leash to the ''[[damane]]'' [[Pura]], actually the [[Yellow Ajah|Yellow]] [[Aes Sedai]] [[Ryma Galfrey]], when [[Suroth]] questions her about how the White Tower controls the Dragon Reborn. She is reprimanded by [[Alwhin]] for not controlling Pura properly, and told to go to [[Surela]].{{ref/book|4|1}}
